subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Resilience Over Efficiency
description: A micro-lesson that makes Resilience Over Efficiency usable.

hook.text: For 30 years, supply chains optimized for cost. Then COVID hit, and the cheapest chains broke first.

buildup.text: Lean, just-in-time, single-source strategies cut costs but removed every buffer against disruption.

discovery.text: Resilient chains keep alternatives ready: backup suppliers, extra stock, and flexible production.

twist.text: Resilience costs money today but saves fortunes when a crisis hits. It's insurance, not waste.

climax.text: Post-COVID, companies are rebalancing—some efficiency for more resilience. The pendulum is swinging.

punchline.text: Cheap until it breaks. Resilient when it matters.

quiz.question: What did COVID reveal about lean supply chains?
